acceptance: Tests cover: lookup miss fails; intended absence is unvalidated and not counted as passed; known expectation match passes; mismatch fails; classified failure and timeout unchanged.
Bundle summaries and the submission validator show unvalidated queries distinctly.
description:
Owner decision 2026-11-11 on comment-cleanup-missing-count-decision: benchbox/core/validation/query_validation.py (about :277-294 and :323-337) returns is_valid=True when no expected count exists, so a lookup miss (typo, missing variant key) and an intended absence of a reference answer both pass silently and count as validated in published bundles.

Change. Distinguish the two. A lookup miss for a benchmark/query that has reference answers fails validation with a named error. An intended absence (benchmark or scale with no reference answers) is recorded as 'unvalidated': not counted as passed, labelled in result bundles and summaries, and visible to the bundle validator. Classified loader failures, timeouts and single-flight publication keep their current behaviour. This is a soundness path: needs the soundness review.

Guardrails: linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment; heavy runs through make heavy-run.
